# 303 Pattern Playground

Canonical URL: https://303box.com/

303 Pattern Playground is a free browser-based 16-step acid bassline pattern generator inspired by classic TB-303 and TD-3 sequencing workflows.

Core capabilities:
- 16-step note sequencing
- Gate, tie and rest programming
- Octave down / up
- Accent and slide
- Saw and square waveforms
- Cutoff, resonance, envelope modulation, decay and accent controls
- 50–250 BPM
- Browser audio preview with Web Audio API
- JPG pattern-sheet export
- English and Turkish interface
- Local browser session persistence

Audience: electronic music producers, acid house and acid techno musicians, TB-303 / TD-3 users and people learning 303-style sequencing.

Main page: https://303box.com/
